You're, like, can barely move more than… you know, the wind is, like, howling, you can… you can… you can see, like, as you step under your feet, like, sometimes it just won't be ground. It'll just be, like, snow, or, like, it's, like, almost trying to trip you. But you all manage to sneak out through the other side,

DM: And as you come out into this other corridor, the… the wind's kinda… calms down a little bit. Like, it's not at all calm. But you… you, get… you sort of… It, it, it, all of a sudden, you could see for… for… 15 feet instead of… or 20 feet instead of 10 feet, right? Like, as you… as you come out into this… sort of wide, icy corridor, but…
DM: You got back to… you went in a loop, and you got back to the spot where the… air is just booming in the air.

markers.reading: Pass the booming barrier again, with Justas carrying Kalima, then reach a circular snowy chamber.

evidence.quote: Finnan: I'll go ahead and just try to run through again. It's 15…
Jrain: So I just rushed past it again. Do I need to check?
DM: No.
Justas: Thank you, I appreciate that. I'll go through again also with Kalima this time.
DM: That's good enough.

DM: As you walk ahead, you… So you cross… you come back out, wow. You think you should come back out into a… into a corner with another passage across, but you actually come to a… to a… circular room, with… Like, a circular, very snowy room with one way out on each of, like… one directly across, one to the left, one to the right.
DM: Yep.

markers.reading: Take the right exit into the narrowing corridor obstructed by hanging ice sheets.

evidence.quote: DM: you see… You come, you turn to the right, and the tunnel that you're walking through, right, like, narrows, and then in front of you, you see these thin sheets of ice hanging from the ceiling, like, almost like curtains, like, like, sort of… many layers, delicate, sort of… the wind sort of stills for a moment here, but… but the ice is still… but there's still enough wind… I mean, there's still a fairly strong howl. It's gotten calmer since you, avoided the… the wind has definitely calmed down a little bit since you avoided the, or, you know, the wind creatures. But it's still… it's still howling strong enough that… it's hard to… it's hard to hear, and there's still, like, this strong… with, you know, strong snow blowing everywhere you go.

DM: But as you look ahead, like, you see, kind of dangling down, not entirely blocking the corridor, but mostly blocking the corridor, these, like, thin veils, like I said, thin veils of ice. There's, like, cool mist kind of pooling around, underneath, but they, they're sort of blocking the corner. I mean, you could… you could sort of push past, right? You might break them, but you could… they're like sheets, like, hanging.

markers.reading: Attempt to run forward through falling ice as an avalanche closes from behind; replenishing ice prevents escape that way.

evidence.quote: DM: So, forward, there's still, like, the bot… there's, like, ice falling. There's some ice, kind of… Ice blocks are falling in front of you, there's an avalanche coming towards you that… mostly… obvious, I mean, you could try and run past the ice blocks, or the wall has just collapsed to your left in… to darkness.
Ekko: Run through the ice sheets.
Finnan: Ice sheets.
Eolo: Ice sheets, yeah.

DM: You smash into the sheets of ice in front of you. And you can… you can hear, like, as you… as you run into them, more and more ice is just… is just falling in front of you, right? Like, there's… it… it… it feels like you smash through one ice sheet, and another one just appears. You make some progress, like, you smash a little bit, but new ice appears, and you can feel the avalanche getting closer. And you can see, like… to your… not only to your left now, but to your right, there's another, like, crash, and the other wall collapses. You're now, like, standing on snow, apparently supported by nothing, with this ice in front of you and an avalanche coming behind you.

markers.reading: Jump through the collapsed right wall, slide down nonreflective ice, and emerge into the air above a large chamber.

evidence.quote: Jrain: Well, now we get to go right, because we love going right.
Justas: Yeah. Into the darkness. This is the time.
DM: You jump down into the darkness, and you slide for a minute.

DM: It's… you can't… whatever material you're standing on, there's, like, there is a material underneath you, but it doesn't seem to reflect light. So it's like, you can't… it just feels like blackness, like you're just… you're just in… your light is there, you can see each other, right? It's not like you can't see. But you don't see anything, there's nothing to see. You're just… you can feel this, like, slick ice. It's like… it's like non-reflective black ice under your feet. I mean, you can't… it's steep. It's, like, this steep. As soon as you go that way, you're, like, sliding.

DM: So… or even a little less. So you slide down through this darkness, you come out in a… in a room, right, you can… you can… you sort of land. It's like you… it's like a slide, right? You come down, like, an ice slide. And as you fall maybe 20 feet, like, go down the slide, like, 20 feet. While you're, again, while you're going down the slide, you can't see, like, there's nothing to your left or right. You're just sliding.

DM: And you come out through the side of a… of a, like, the side of a… a wall, and you… everybody actually… well, Kenku, so you… you come out maybe 20 feet above… like, you're coming out into the air, about 20 feet up, on the, like, side of a wall. It's like a large, maybe 100-foot across chamber, although you can't actually see more than 40 feet. There's no storm here. You can see in the moment, as you come…

DM: the… The walls near to you are, like, sheer ice. The floor is, like… black stone. There's… some scattered rocks in the distance, you can't quite… see past them, but there's clearly, like, a boulder fall a little bit away. And now you're falling, you have, like, one second to do something.

route.reading: Slide down the slick dark surface.

duration.basis: DM narrates a minute of sliding

markers.reading: Justas catches the upper ice wall with his axe and holds Kalima in the other arm.

evidence.quote: DM: So, thinking of Finnan's stories of heroic conquest, you're like, nope, I can do this, and you get your axe into the ice, and you're hanging 17 feet up, holding on to… Kalima, with one arm, and… your axe with the other arm. This probably will only hold for 30 seconds, maybe? Or a minute, like, you would… it's not a very comfortable position to be, but…

markers.reading: Control the slide down the wall and land on the chamber floor.

evidence.quote: DM: you manage… so Jrain is slipping down the ice and manages to… catch, like, a… a bit of a… icicle, you don't… you don't… you can't… there's nothing really to hold on to, but you manage to, like, control your slide, and, like… kind of… hold, like… Catch on to a few places that let you kind of… more gently… guide yourself, like, you turn it from a fall into a controlled descent, and you land relatively comfortably… in the scheme of things. So you're on the bottom.

markers.reading: The Kenku fly above the floor; Finnan catches Eolo and remains supported in the air.

evidence.quote: DM: Justas is 20… 17 feet above you. The Kenku are… I don't know what the… they're flying.

DM: You grab on… so, Finnan manages to grab, Eolo's leg as you, like, lift your wings. You're… you're… It's a little tough to… keep flying… with him hanging onto your wing, but the wind is strangely quiet here, so you're okay.

markers.reading: Ekko retrieves Kalima from Justas; after reassurance and renewed fear, she accepts hiding behind Finnan’s illusory wall below.

evidence.quote: Justas: Grab her, I'll call over.
Ekko: Over and grab her.
DM: Okay, she kind of looks over to… to Ekko, and it seems willing to be carried by you.
DM: She's scrambling away from, from… from the room, almost. She's like… 'It's here somewhere.'
Finnan: I will use Minor Illusion to extend the ice wall by 5 feet, right in… right below… Justas.
Finnan: Telepathically tell… yeah, yeah. Kalima to hide there.
DM: She'll hide behind the ice wall. She'll accept that. How's Justas getting down? He's just jumping?

markers.note: Kalima accepts hiding behind the illusion below Justas; neither its exact elevation nor Ekko’s own landing is stated.

markers.reading: Drop from the ice wall and land awkwardly on the black-stone floor.

evidence.quote: Justas: Yeah, I think when Justas hears… Tim, you're echoing again… I think when Justas hears that the, the beast is in this space, he smiles broadly, and just jiggles his wall, his axe out of the wall, and drops to the ground, ready for a fight.
DM: He'll take the 3 points of damage. You'll land a little awkwardly. Bruise something or other.

DM: So you're in this room. There's some rocks over on the far side that you can't see through. Otherwise, the floor is… black stone of some kind. And the… the… it's a circular, so you can see, like, the half… the sort of half circle.
